name_story.story: Shukri can be understood through the Arabic form شُكْرِي, whose central sense is shukri; of thanksgiving (relative form). Shukri is Arabic شُكْرِيّ (Shukrī), the relative form of شُكْر (thanksgiving), used as a male given name.

faq.a: Shukri is associated with the Arabic form شُكْرِي, whose core sense is shukri; of thanksgiving (relative form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Shukri?
faq.a: Shukri is associated with Arabic. Shukri is Arabic شُكْرِيّ (Shukrī), the relative form of شُكْر (thanksgiving), used as a male given name.
Yes — the underlying form شُكْرِي is Arabic.
Shukri can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Shukri should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Shukrī is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Shukri mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Shukri is rendered شکری and carries the sense شکری، شکر سے منسوب.

faq.q: What does Shukri mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Shukri is rendered شکری and carries the sense شکری، منسوب به شکر.
A romanized syllable approximation is shuk-ri. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Shukri?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Shukri, shukri. Script forms are شُكْرِي, شکري, شکری, शुक्री.

faq.q: Is Shukri a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
